import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod = 1000000007;
    static long N, K;
    static int MAX_K = 70;
    static int MAX_INDEX = 35;
    static Matrix[][] mat = new Matrix[MAX_INDEX][MAX_K];

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] A;

        public Matrix() {}

        public Matrix(int n, int m) {
            A = new long[n][m];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(A[i], 0);
            }
        }

        public Matrix(int n) {
            this(n, n);
        }

        public int height() {
            return A.length;
        }

        public int width() {
            return A[0].length;
        }

        public long[] getRow(int k) {
            return A[k];
        }

        public long[] getColumn(int k) {
            long[] col = new long[A.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < A.length; i++) {
                col[i] = A[i][k];
            }
            return col;
        }

        public static Matrix I(int n) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                mat.A[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return mat;
        }

        public Matrix add(Matrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = width();
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    res.A[i][j] = (A[i][j] + B.A[i][j]) % mod;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        public Matrix subtract(Matrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = width();
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    res.A[i][j] = (A[i][j] - B.A[i][j] + mod) % mod;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        public Matrix multiply(Matrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = B.width(), p = width();
            Matrix C = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        sum += A[i][k] * B.A[k][j];
                    }
                    C.A[i][j] = sum % mod;
                }
            }
            return C;
        }

        public Matrix pow(long k) {
            Matrix B = Matrix.I(height());
            Matrix base = this;
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                    B = B.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            return B;
        }

        public void rot() {
            int size = A.length;
            Matrix B = new Matrix(size + 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    B.A[i][j] = A[(i + size - 1) % size][(j + size - 1) % size];
                }
                B.A[i][size] = A[(i + size - 1) % size][size];
                B.A[size][i] = A[size][(i + size - 1) % size];
            }
            B.A[size][size] = A[size][size];
            for (int i = 0; i < A.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < A[0].length; j++) {
                    A[i][j] = B.A[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long beki(long a, long b) {
        long ret = 1;
        long base = a;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                ret = (ret * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();

        int INDEX = 0;
        long copy = N;
        while (copy >= K) {
            INDEX++;
            copy /= K;
        }

        // Initialize mat[0][0]
        mat[0][0] = Matrix.I((int)K + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            mat[0][0].A[0][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
            mat[0][i] = mat[0][i - 1];
            mat[0][i].rot();
        }

        for (int index = 1; index <= INDEX; index++) {
            mat[index][0] = mat[index - 1][0];
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[index][0] = mat[index - 1][i].multiply(mat[index][0]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[index][i] = mat[index][i - 1];
                mat[index][i].rot();
            }
        }

        long[] ans = new long[(int)K + 1];
        ans[(int)K] = 1;

        int used = 0;
        while (INDEX >= 0) {
            for (;;) {
                if (beki(K, INDEX) <= N) {
                    N -= beki(K, INDEX);
                    Matrix temp = mat[INDEX][used];
                    long[][] newAns = new long[(int)K + 1][1];
                    for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
                        newAns[i][0] = 0;
                        for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                            newAns[i][0] += temp.A[i][j] * ans[j];
                        }
                        newAns[i][0] %= mod;
                    }
                    for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
                        ans[i] = newAns[i][0];
                    }
                    used++;
                    used %= K;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            INDEX--;
        }

        long val = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            val += ans[i];
        }
        val %= mod;
        System.out.println(val);
        sc.close();
    }
}
